Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = userid),
		isUpdated: Boolean = false
	precondition:
		card.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		card.CardStatus = CardStatus.NORMAL and
		card.Name = name and
		card.Address = address and
		result = true
}
